name: bhavya-agrawal-portfolio
description: Portfolio site for Bhavya Agrawal — Cinematographer / DOP. React (Vite) client + Express API.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,yellow "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start --prefix server
